envVars.name: APP_TEMPLATE_HOME
envVars.description: abap2UI5/app-template checkout that scaffold_app serves and add_agent_setup executes. Default: ../app-template, else the GitHub mirror.

envVars.name: DOCS_HOME
envVars.description: abap2UI5/docs checkout that docs_search reads. Default: ../docs, else the GitHub mirror.

envVars.name: ABAP_CLOUD_GUI_HOME
envVars.description: abap2UI5-addons/abap-cloud-gui checkout (with npm ci done) whose report2cloud converter migrate_report runs. Default: ../abap-cloud-gui; no mirror.

envVars.name: POPUPS_HOME
envVars.description: abap2UI5-addons/popups checkout whose popups migrate_report with deploy: true writes into the dev sandbox beside the converted class. Default: .deps/popups of the abap-cloud-gui checkout, ../popups beside it, then its build/popups.

envVars.name: OPENUI5_SRC
envVars.description: OpenUI5 source checkout scope_of reads the JSDoc from (via samples-controls). Default: ../fork-openui5 next to samples-controls.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_WORKSPACE
envVars.description: Where the npm backend installs, the dev sandbox lives and a framework clone lands. Default: ~/.abap2ui5-mcp.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_BACKEND
envVars.description: Which backend runs the apps: npm (the @abap2ui5/node-runtime package, even beside a checkout) or clone (clone the framework). Default: decided per call.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_RUNTIME_VERSION
envVars.description: Pin the @abap2ui5/node-runtime release (X.Y.Z) the npm backend installs. Default: the registry's latest.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_PORT
envVars.description: Port of the local backend run_app boots against. Default: 3000.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_UI
envVars.description: Whether app_start/app_describe/app_act declare their MCP Apps screen (ui://abap2ui5/app-screen): auto (default - when the client advertises the io.modelcontextprotocol/ui extension), on, off.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_APP_FORMAT
envVars.description: The default answer format of the app tools: snapshot (default) or adaptive-card (the snapshot plus an Adaptive Card 1.5 as an embedded resource, for card-rendering hosts).

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_OFFLINE
envVars.description: Set to 1 for no network: no UI5 CDN fallback, no GitHub mirror, no registry lookup.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_REMOTE
envVars.description: Set to 0 to switch off the read-only GitHub mirror used when no checkout is found.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_REMOTE_DIR
envVars.description: Cache directory of the GitHub mirror. Default: <tmp>/abap2ui5-mcp-remote.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_REMOTE_TTL_MS
envVars.description: How long a mirrored copy is used before it is refreshed, in milliseconds. Default: one day.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_UI5_CACHE_MB
envVars.description: How many MB of UI5 answers from the CDN (sdk.openui5.org) run_app and interact_app keep in memory across calls, so a second boot does not download them again. 0 switches the cache off. Default: 64.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_RENDER_PAGES
envVars.description: Pages (Chromium tabs) of validate_view's warm render gate, which concurrent calls queue on. Default: 2 (1 to 8).

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_CHROMIUM
envVars.description: Chromium binary for run_app and interact_app. Default: CHROMIUM_BIN, Playwright's managed browser, then a system chromium.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_SCREENSHOT_DIR
envVars.description: Where run_app and interact_app write their PNGs (the newest 50 are kept) and build_backend its log. Default: <tmp>/abap2ui5-mcp-screenshots.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_PREBUILT_URL
envVars.description: Where build_backend mode prebuilt downloads the backend from. Default: the framework's release asset.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_LINT_WORKER

description: Standalone Obsidian vault server: hybrid search, notes and files, memory and tasks; run locally or self-host for remote access.

envVars.name: MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
envVars.description: Bearer token for MCP client authentication. Must match the Authorization header sent by clients. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

envVars.name: PUBLIC_URL
envVars.description: Public URL clients use to reach this server. Used as the OAuth issuer URL in discovery metadata. Override when exposing the server outside localhost or on a non-default port.

envVars.name: EMBEDDING_ENABLED
envVars.description: Enable or disable the embedding pipeline. When false, no ONNX model is downloaded, no vector tables are created, and search uses FTS5 only.

envVars.name: RERANK_MODE
envVars.description: Cross-encoder reranking mode: blended (position-aware score blending after RRF fusion) or none (skip reranking). Only takes effect when EMBEDDING_ENABLED is true.

envVars.name: WINDOWS_MODE
envVars.description: Windows bind-mount mode: enables filesystem polling for the file watcher and rename-based moves across the Docker Desktop/WSL2 bridge. Set to true when the vault lives on a Windows drive.

envVars.name: MEMORY_ENABLED
envVars.description: Enable or disable the structured memory layer. When false, memory tools are hidden, bootstrap is skipped, and server metadata omits memory references.

envVars.name: FILE_TOOLS_ENABLED
envVars.description: Enable or disable file tools (vault_read_file, vault_list_files). When false, file tools are hidden and server metadata omits file tool references.

envVars.name: READONLY_MODE
envVars.description: Run the server read-only: every vault-writing tool is hidden, the memory folder is not auto-created, and server metadata omits write references.

envVars.name: DISABLED_TOOLS
envVars.description: Hide individual tools by name, comma-separated. Subtractive only — it cannot re-enable a tool another setting hides; an unknown tool name stops the server at startup.

envVars.name: MEMORY_DIR
envVars.description: Vault folder for structured memory files (About Me-style notes). Memory tools are hidden when MEMORY_ENABLED is false, but this value still feeds the defaults for PROTECTED_PATHS and ORPHAN_EXCLUDE_FOLDERS.

envVars.name: DAILY_NOTES_FOLDER
envVars.description: Vault folder for daily notes. Overrides the folder configured in Obsidian's daily-notes plugin. When unset, read from the vault's .obsidian/daily-notes.json (an empty folder there follows Obsidian's new-note location), falling back to "Daily Notes" when that file is missing or unreadable. Set to / for the vault root.

envVars.name: DAILY_NOTES_FORMAT
envVars.description: Filename date format for daily notes (Moment.js tokens). Overrides the format configured in Obsidian's daily-notes plugin. When unset, read from the vault's .obsidian/daily-notes.json, falling back to "YYYY-MM-DD".

envVars.name: TRUST_PROXY_HOPS
envVars.description: Number of trusted reverse-proxy hops used to derive the client IP from X-Forwarded-For for OAuth rate limiting and request logs. With 0, injected forwarding headers are ignored.

envVars.name: TRUST_FORWARDED_HOPS
envVars.description: How many entries from the end of the RFC 7239 Forwarded header's for= list to count to reach the client IP for OAuth rate limiting and request logs. 0 ignores the header; 1 when the proxy in front writes it (e.g. AWS API Gateway); 2 when a CDN fronts that proxy and is the only way to reach it.

envVars.name: TZ
envVars.description: IANA timezone for timestamps and daily note resolution.

envVars.name: LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Logging verbosity.

envVars.name: LOG_DIR
envVars.description: Directory for log files that survive container re-creation. The container's own log is always written but discarded when the container is recreated; date-stamped files under LOG_DIR persist on the data volume. Default: /data/logs (remote image), $STORAGE_ROOT/data/logs (single-volume mode), none (local image). none keeps only the container log.

envVars.name: LOG_RETENTION_DAYS
envVars.description: Days to keep log files before automatic cleanup on startup; only applies when LOG_DIR is a path.

envVars.name: PROTECTED_PATHS
envVars.description: Comma-separated vault folder names blocked from vault_delete_note and vault_move_note. Default: MEMORY_DIR plus the daily notes folder, read from DAILY_NOTES_FOLDER or .obsidian/daily-notes.json (default Daily Notes; none when that setting is the vault root or empty). When set, overrides the default entirely.

envVars.name: ORPHAN_EXCLUDE_FOLDERS
envVars.description: Comma-separated vault folder names excluded from vault_find_orphans. Default: the daily notes folder, "Templates", and MEMORY_DIR. DAILY_NOTES_FOLDER wins; otherwise .obsidian/daily-notes.json is read per query (fallback "Daily Notes"; no daily folder when that setting is the vault root or empty). When set, replaces the defaults entirely. Set to a comma (,) to exclude nothing; an empty value uses the defaults.

envVars.name: SERVICE_DOCUMENTATION_URL
envVars.description: Override the OAuth service documentation URL exposed via discovery metadata.

envVars.name: MAX_FILE_BYTES
envVars.description: Largest file vault_read_file will read, in bytes. Reading a larger file returns an error instead of content.

envVars.name: MAX_IMAGE_OUTPUT_BYTES
envVars.description: Byte budget for images returned by vault_read_file, in binary bytes before base64 encoding. Images exceeding the budget are downscaled/recompressed server-side to fit; raise for clients that accept larger tool responses.

envVars.name: MAX_PDF_RENDER_PAGES
envVars.description: Maximum PDF pages to render as images when raw: true is set on vault_read_file. The per-page byte budget is MAX_IMAGE_OUTPUT_BYTES divided evenly across the rendered pages.

envVars.description: TLS mode. require/allow/prefer encrypt without verifying the certificate; verify-ca/verify-full verify it (supply a CA via PG_SSL_CA). Unlike libpq, allow/prefer do not fall back to plaintext, so a server without TLS needs disable.

envVars.name: PG_SSL_CA
envVars.description: Path to a CA certificate file. Setting it by itself implies verify-full.

envVars.name: PG_ENABLE_RUNTIME_CONNECT
envVars.description: Register the connect_db tool (runtime credential switching).

envVars.name: PG_MAX_RESULT_BYTES
envVars.description: Byte budget for a query result sent to the model. Whole rows are kept while they fit; over the budget returnedRows < rowCount and truncated is true.

envVars.name: PG_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: Statement timeout in milliseconds, applied to every session.

envVars.name: PG_CONNECT_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: Timeout in milliseconds for a single connect attempt (raise it for slow links or SSH tunnels).

envVars.name: PG_SSH_HOST
envVars.description: SSH bastion host. Setting it enables tunneling: the server reaches the database only through an SSH tunnel to this host. Needs the ssh2 optional dependency.

envVars.name: PG_SSH_PORT
envVars.description: SSH bastion port.

envVars.name: PG_SSH_USER
envVars.description: SSH username.

envVars.name: PG_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY
envVars.description: Path to a private key file. If unset, auth falls back like ssh: a running agent (SSH_AUTH_SOCK), then a default key (~/.ssh/id_ed25519, id_rsa, id_ecdsa).

envVars.name: PG_SSH_PASSPHRASE
envVars.description: Passphrase for the private key, if encrypted.

envVars.name: PG_SSH_AGENT
envVars.description: true to use the ambient agent (SSH_AUTH_SOCK), or an explicit socket path / Windows named pipe.

envVars.name: PG_SSH_PASSWORD
envVars.description: SSH login password. Opt-in; a key or agent takes precedence. Prefer keys, a bastion often disables password auth.

envVars.name: PG_SSH_FINGERPRINT
envVars.description: Pinned host-key fingerprint (SHA256:...). Host-key verification is mandatory and set only this way: without it the tunnel refuses to connect. Get it with ssh-keygen -lF host.

envVars.name: PG_SSH_KEEPALIVE_INTERVAL
envVars.description: SSH keepalive interval in ms; the tunnel drops after 3 unanswered keepalives, and the next call reconnects.

envVars.name: APPLE_SAFARI_ALLOW_WRITES
envVars.description: Register the mutating tools. Off by default, and the gate decides whether the write tools exist at all rather than merely refusing — an agent with writes off cannot see them.

envVars.name: APPLE_SAFARI_ALLOW_CODES
envVars.description: Return one-time codes: a one-time-code field in apple_safari_page_elements, and apple_safari_find_codes for a code a page shows as text. Its own gate rather than allowWrites, because it is a read. Credential fields stay redacted whatever this says.

envVars.name: APPLE_SAFARI_ALLOW_NETWORK
envVars.description: Register apple_safari_network_record, _list and _get, which record what a page you allowed the extension on fetches and read the responses. Its own gate rather than allowWrites, because it is a read; off means the tools do not exist. Headers named like credentials are masked, bodies are not. Reloading a tab to record and saving a body to a file still need APPLE_SAFARI_ALLOW_WRITES.

envVars.name: APPLE_SAFARI_DOWNLOAD_DIR
envVars.description: Where apple_safari_network_get's saveAs writes a file. Defaults to ~/Downloads. A name is kept to its basename and an existing file is never replaced unless asked.

envVars.name: APPLE_SAFARI_NETWORK_CHUNK_CHARS
envVars.description: Characters of a body the server asks the page for per command when it reads a large body. Defaults to 262144, which was measured to work; how far above that Safari's native-message channel goes is unmeasured.

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_LABEL
envVars.description: Names this agent's tab ownership. Two agents with different labels never see each other's owned tabs. Defaults to "default".

envVars.description: With ARC_MCP_WINDOW=space, the Arc space new tabs open into, when a space with that name exists. Arc will not let a script create a space, so make it by hand. Defaults to "Agent".

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_STATE_DIR
envVars.description: Directory where per-session tab ownership is recorded, so a restarted agent can clean up the tabs its previous run left behind. Defaults to ~/Library/Application Support/arc-control-mcp.

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_WINDOW
envVars.description: "dedicated" keeps agent tabs in one separate agent window, never the user's own. "space" puts them in the Agent space of the user's window. Defaults to "dedicated".

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_WINDOW_PLACEMENT
envVars.description: Where the agent window goes once, at creation: "auto" (largest non-main display, else where Arc puts it), "second-display", "minimized" (experimental) or "none". Needs Accessibility. Defaults to "auto".

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_IDLE_MS
envVars.description: How many milliseconds the user must have been idle before the server does anything visible. 0 turns the activity gate off. Defaults to 1500.

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_IDLE_WAIT_MS
envVars.description: How many milliseconds to wait for that pause before failing with userActive true. Defaults to 15000.

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_ARC_DATA_DIR
envVars.description: Directory the local data tools (sidebar_tree, find_stale_tabs, search_archive, search_history) read Arc's files from. Defaults to ~/Library/Application Support/Arc.

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_ALLOW_HISTORY
envVars.description: Set to 1 to let search_history run. Off by default, and any other value leaves it off.

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_CDP
envVars.description: Set to 0 to disable the DevTools engine (trusted input, screenshots, console and network capture). On by default, and inert until Arc is launched with --remote-debugging-port.

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_CDP_PORT
envVars.description: The DevTools port to probe on 127.0.0.1. The host is fixed. Defaults to 9222.

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
envVars.description: Guardrail. Comma list of origins the agent may touch (host, *.host, scheme://host[:port], file://, about:). Anything not listed is refused. Unset means no allow list.

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_BLOCKED_ORIGINS
envVars.description: Guardrail. Comma list of origins the agent may not touch. Wins over the allow list. Unset means no block list.

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_BLOCK_READS
envVars.description: Set to 1 to apply the origin lists to read tools as well as changing ones. Off by default.

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_READ_ONLY
envVars.description: Set to 1 to expose only the read-only tools. Off by default.

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_AUDIT_LOG
envVars.description: Path of a file that gets one JSON line per changing call (time, tool, tab, origin, ok, error), never typed values or script code. Unset means no audit log.

envVars.description: Private key of the wallet that pays for calls. The server only SIGNS an EIP-3009 authorisation; it never sends a transaction. Also required: ALLOW_OUTBOUND_SPEND=1, and this key is not loaded into the process without it. Never set this to the payee/treasury wallet: that is rejected.

envVars.name: ALLOW_OUTBOUND_SPEND

envVars.description: Per-call ceiling in USDC base units (6 decimals, so 10000 = 0.01 USDC). A requirement above it is refused before signing.

envVars.name: AUTOMATON_MCP_TOTAL_CAP_UNITS
envVars.description: Ceiling for the whole process lifetime, in USDC base units. Stops a runaway loop, not just a single expensive call.

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT
envVars.description: When set, serve Streamable HTTP on this port instead of stdio. Binds to 127.0.0.1 by default.

envVars.name: CHAINMEMORY_API_KEY
envVars.description: ChainMemory API key. REQUIRED for every tool except chainmemory_seal. Get one at https://faucet.chainmemory.ai

envVars.name: CHAINMEMORY_SEED_PHRASE
envVars.description: 12-word BIP-39 phrase for the blind vault. Optional: without it the server works exactly as before. With it, sealed:true encrypts a memory on your machine and computes its search vector here, so sealed memories can still be found, and searches send the query's vector instead of its text. Generate one with chainmemory_new_seed. It never leaves your machine and cannot be recovered.

envVars.name: CHAINMEMORY_API_BASE
envVars.description: API base URL (default: https://api.chainmemory.ai)

envVars.name: CHAINMEMORY_MODELS_DIR
envVars.description: Folder for the 45 MB search model used with the blind vault (default: ~/.chainmemory/models). Downloaded once from models.chainmemory.ai and checked against its SHA-256 anchored on ChainMemory's chain.

envVars.name: CHAINMEMORY_ALLOW_FULL
envVars.description: Set to 1 to let get_project_brief return the FULL level (addresses, ports, server paths and security rules) when you ask for it. Leave it empty to keep every brief at the public level, which is safe to paste anywhere. Works only with the owner's key, and ChainMemory logs every full-level request.

envVars.name: AICHAIN_KEY
envVars.description: NOT NEEDED for normal use — leave it empty. Only the chainmemory_seal tool reads it, to sign a contract call yourself instead of letting the API anchor the memory (which chainmemory_remember already does). If you do set it, it is a wallet private key: use a dedicated wallet holding only a few AIC, never your main one. No other tool uses it.

envVars.name: AICHAIN_RPC
envVars.description: RPC endpoint used only by chainmemory_seal (default: https://rpc.chainmemory.ai). Leave it empty unless you set AICHAIN_KEY.

envVars.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_ALLOWED_MODELS

envVars.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_DEFAULT_SANDBOX
envVars.description: Sandbox used when a call specifies none: read-only, workspace-write or danger-full-access. Defaults to read-only and cannot exceed the ceiling.

envVars.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_MAX_SANDBOX
envVars.description: Ceiling on what a delegation may do: read-only, workspace-write or danger-full-access. Defaults to workspace-write; danger-full-access must be set explicitly.

envVars.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_MAX_EFFORT
envVars.description: Ceiling on reasoning effort: none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max or ultra. Unset: unrestricted. Higher efforts are lowered to a supported level, or refused if none fits.

name: com.bluecat/integritymcp
description: BlueCat Integrity MCP Server (formerly bammcp)

envVars.name: BAM_BASE_URL
envVars.description: BAM base URL (e.g., https://bam.bluecat.com).

envVars.name: BAM_USERNAME
envVars.description: BAM service-account username. Required unless the SSO pair (BAM_SSO_USERNAME + BAM_SSO_PASSWORD) is used instead — the server needs exactly one of the two pairs.

envVars.name: BAM_PASSWORD
envVars.description: BAM service-account password. Required alongside BAM_USERNAME, unless the SSO pair is used instead.

envVars.name: BAM_SSO_USERNAME
envVars.description: BAM SSO username. Alternative to BAM_USERNAME + BAM_PASSWORD; the server needs exactly one of the two pairs.

envVars.name: BAM_SSO_PASSWORD
envVars.description: BAM SSO password. Required alongside BAM_SSO_USERNAME when using the SSO pair.

envVars.name: MCP_AUTH_MODE
envVars.description: Client authentication mode for the /mcp endpoint. One of: none | static-key | signed-key | resource-server. Required at runtime — the server refuses to start without it (no default).

envVars.name: MCP_API_KEY
envVars.description: Static bearer token clients present as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Required only when MCP_AUTH_MODE=static-key.

envVars.name: MCP_REQUEST_STATE_KEY
envVars.description: HMAC key (at least 32 bytes) sealing the approval-gated write tools' requestState on MCP 2026-07-28 connections (#1031). Optional: unset uses a random per-process key, which is fine for a single replica; set the same value on every replica of a multi-replica deployment.

envVars.name: MCP_REQUEST_STATE_KEY_PREVIOUS
envVars.description: Second requestState HMAC key, accepted for opening a sealed plan but never for sealing one: two-key rotation of MCP_REQUEST_STATE_KEY (#1032). Optional, and only valid together with MCP_REQUEST_STATE_KEY. When rolling the key across replicas set this to the old key, and remove it two minutes after the last replica restarted.

envVars.name: MCP_ED25519_PUBLIC_KEY
envVars.description: Ed25519 public key (base64url) that MCP_AUTH_MODE=signed-key verifies license tokens against. DEFAULTS TO A SHARED DEMO KEY, which authenticates a token holder rather than a customer — every BlueCat-issued token for this server verifies against it. For anything beyond a trial, generate a per-deployment key pair (license-keygen --gen-key) and set this to its public half.

envVars.name: MCP_SIGNED_KEY_AUDIENCE
envVars.description: When set, a license token must carry exactly this audience or it is rejected — a declarative scope check on top of the key, so a token minted for another deployment fails even if it verifies. Unset means the aud claim is not checked. Only meaningful with MCP_AUTH_MODE=signed-key.

envVars.name: MCP_OAUTH_ISSUER
envVars.description: Token issuer URL, matched against the iss claim of incoming JWTs. Required when MCP_AUTH_MODE=resource-server — the server refuses to start in that mode without it.

envVars.name: MCP_OAUTH_JWKS_URI
envVars.description: JWKS endpoint whose public keys verify the signature on every incoming Bearer JWT. Required when MCP_AUTH_MODE=resource-server — the server refuses to start in that mode without it.

envVars.name: MCP_OAUTH_AUDIENCE
envVars.description: Expected JWT aud claim for MCP_AUTH_MODE=resource-server. A token carrying a different audience, or no aud claim at all, is rejected. Unset skips audience validation entirely.

envVars.name: ACCEPT_EULA
envVars.description: Set to Y (or Yes/YES, any casing) to accept the BlueCat End User License Agreement. The container refuses to start without it.

envVars.name: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
envVars.description: BigQuery: path to a service-account key file (Application Default Credentials). Required to use the bigquery engine.

envVars.name: SNOWFLAKE_ACCOUNT
envVars.description: Snowflake: account identifier. Required to use the snowflake engine.

envVars.name: SNOWFLAKE_USER
envVars.description: Snowflake: username. Required to use the snowflake engine.

envVars.name: SNOWFLAKE_ROLE
envVars.description: Snowflake: role to assume. Required to use the snowflake engine; has no default and must never be ACCOUNTADMIN (ACCOUNTADMIN, SECURITYADMIN and ORGADMIN are rejected before any Snowflake connection is opened - the check runs when the Snowflake configuration is first loaded, on the first Snowflake tool call; the server process itself starts regardless, so a bad role surfaces as a failed check_credentials or a tool error, not as a startup exit).

envVars.name: SNOWFLAKE_SECONDARY_ROLES
envVars.description: Snowflake: secondary roles activated at login. NONE (default) means only SNOWFLAKE_ROLE is active in the session; ALL is the explicit opt-out that activates every role granted to SNOWFLAKE_USER.

envVars.name: SNOWFLAKE_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH
envVars.description: Snowflake: path to an RSA private key file for key-pair auth (preferred over SNOWFLAKE_PASSWORD). Either this or SNOWFLAKE_PASSWORD is required to use the snowflake engine.

envVars.name: SNOWFLAKE_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSPHRASE

envVars.name: SNOWFLAKE_PASSWORD
envVars.description: Snowflake: password (discouraged; prefer SNOWFLAKE_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH). Either this or SNOWFLAKE_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH is required to use the snowflake engine.

envVars.name: SNOWFLAKE_EDITION
envVars.description: Snowflake: account edition that sets the USD/credit price of estimates - standard (default), enterprise, business_critical or vps. The per-call edition argument can only raise it.

envVars.name: DATABRICKS_SERVER_HOSTNAME
envVars.description: Databricks: SQL warehouse server hostname (e.g. my-workspace.cloud.databricks.com, no scheme, no trailing slash). Required to use the databricks engine.

envVars.name: DATABRICKS_HTTP_PATH
envVars.description: Databricks: SQL warehouse HTTP path (from the warehouse's Connection Details tab, e.g. /sql/1.0/warehouses/<warehouse-id>). Required to use the databricks engine.

envVars.name: DATABRICKS_TOKEN
envVars.description: Databricks: personal access token (simplest auth option). Either this or DATABRICKS_CLIENT_ID + DATABRICKS_CLIENT_SECRET is required to use the databricks engine.

envVars.name: DATABRICKS_CLIENT_ID
envVars.description: Databricks: OAuth machine-to-machine service-principal client ID (preferred for automated use). Requires DATABRICKS_CLIENT_SECRET as well.

envVars.name: DATABRICKS_CLIENT_SECRET
envVars.description: Databricks: OAuth machine-to-machine service-principal client secret. Requires DATABRICKS_CLIENT_ID as well.

envVars.name: COST_GUARD_ALLOW_MULTI_STATEMENT_SQL
envVars.description: Set to 1 to let estimate_query_cost/run_query_bounded accept text containing more than one SQL statement. Off by default: the cost cap is only known to cover the single statement the dry run/EXPLAIN priced. Skips only this server's scanner: Snowflake still rejects multi-statement text (sessions are pinned to MULTI_STATEMENT_COUNT=1), and only a single SELECT/WITH/VALUES statement is wrapped in a LIMIT subquery - a script runs unwrapped and its row cap (max_rows, default 1000) is enforced by the paged fetch.

envVars.name: COST_GUARD_ALLOW_WRITE_STATEMENTS
envVars.description: Set to 1 (exactly that value) to let estimate_query_cost/run_query_bounded accept statements that are not reads. Off by default: only text whose first keyword (after comments and opening parentheses) is SELECT, WITH, VALUES, SHOW, DESCRIBE, DESC or EXPLAIN is estimated or run - a WITH must be followed by a SELECT or VALUES - because warehouse rows re-enter the model's context and can steer the next call. The gate is defence in depth: the authorisation boundary is the credential's grants (deploy a read-only principal). With COST_GUARD_ALLOW_MULTI_STATEMENT_SQL=1 every statement in the text must be a read, so BigQuery scripts (DECLARE/SET/BEGIN) need both opt-outs. Any other value leaves the gate on.

envVars.name: COST_GUARD_MAX_IN_FLIGHT_QUERIES
envVars.description: Maximum number of run_query_bounded calls allowed in flight at once (positive integer, default 8). A cancelled call keeps its slot until its warehouse query completes or the 120 s watchdog fires; a call over the cap fails with a tool error naming this variable before any warehouse connection is opened.

envVars.name: COST_GUARD_DATABRICKS_ALLOW_WAREHOUSE_START
envVars.description: Set to true (exactly that value) to let the read-only Databricks tools (check_credentials, estimate_query_cost) open a session on a SQL warehouse that is not RUNNING, which starts the warehouse and bills compute until it auto-stops. Off by default: the server first reads the warehouse's state through the Warehouses API (GET /api/2.0/sql/warehouses/<id>, CAN_VIEW/CAN_USE suffices) and, unless it is RUNNING - also when the state cannot be read - check_credentials returns ok=false and estimate_query_cost returns no byte or dollar figure, without opening a session. run_query_bounded is not gated: its own pre-execution estimate and the execution may start the warehouse. Any other value leaves the guard on.

envVars.name: COST_GUARD_SNOWFLAKE_ALLOW_WAREHOUSE_RESUME
envVars.description: Set to true (exactly that value) to let the read-only Snowflake tools run SELECT CURRENT_REGION(), the INFORMATION_SCHEMA.QUERY_HISTORY read and check_credentials' session-context SELECT on a warehouse that is not STARTED, which can resume a suspended AUTO_RESUME warehouse and bill compute until it auto-suspends. Off by default: those statements are skipped unless the pinned warehouse's SHOW WAREHOUSES state is STARTED (also skipped when no warehouse is pinned or the state cannot be read), and the QUERY_HISTORY read is skipped whenever estimate_query_cost is called without a warehouse argument; estimate_query_cost then prices at Gen1 rates with the byte-tier heuristic and says so in a caveat, and check_credentials returns ok=true with a detail built from the SHOW WAREHOUSES row. USE WAREHOUSE, EXPLAIN USING JSON, SHOW WAREHOUSES and SELECT CURRENT_WAREHOUSE() always run; run_query_bounded is not gated. Any other value leaves the guard on.

envVars.name: LOADER_PATH
envVars.description: Directory Spring Boot's PropertiesLauncher scans for extension jars; already set to /app/adapters by the image, but startup still fails with MISSING_SOURCE_ADAPTER until you bind-mount a reviewed DataSourceAdapter/IdentityResolver jar there (see the -v arguments above)

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_JWT_ISSUER
envVars.description: OAuth2/OIDC issuer that mints the caller's JWT; required for every protected deployment

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_JWT_AUDIENCE
envVars.description: Expected JWT audience claim for this deployment; required for every protected deployment

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_JWT_JWK_SET_URI
envVars.description: HTTPS JWKS location used to verify caller JWTs; exactly one of this or DATAPRISM_SECURITY_JWT_ISSUER_DISCOVERY_URI is required, never both

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_JWT_ISSUER_DISCOVERY_URI
envVars.description: Alternative HTTPS OIDC issuer-discovery location; set this instead of DATAPRISM_SECURITY_JWT_JWK_SET_URI, never both

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_CALLER_CLAIMS_PRINCIPAL
envVars.description: JWT claim name that carries the caller's principal identifier; required, must differ from the roles and investigation claims

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_CALLER_CLAIMS_ROLES
envVars.description: JWT claim name that carries the caller's roles; required, must differ from the principal and investigation claims

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_CALLER_CLAIMS_INVESTIGATION
envVars.description: JWT claim name that carries the trusted investigation/case identifier; required, must differ from the principal and roles claims

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_POLICY_PURPOSES
envVars.description: Comma-separated list of permitted purposes; at least one is required

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITYPOLICY_ROLES_INVESTIGATOR
envVars.description: Example only — declare DATAPRISM_SECURITYPOLICY_ROLES_<ROLE> per operator-defined role (no underscore between SECURITY and POLICY: Spring Boot's map-key enumeration under a hyphenated dataprism.security-policy.roles.<role> segment only binds the concatenated prefix, verified by binding this property directly against Spring Boot 4.1.1), a comma-separated list of known MCP tool capabilities; at least one role-to-capability mapping is required

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_PRIVACY_PROFILE
envVars.description: Name of the reviewed privacy profile implementation to apply; required

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_PRIVACY_SCOPE_LIFETIME
envVars.description: Positive duration (e.g. 8h) a privacy scope's synthetic identities remain valid; required

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_PRIVACY_HMAC_KEY_KEY_ID
envVars.description: Identifier of the pinned HMAC key used to derive synthetic identities; required

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_PRIVACY_HMAC_KEY_ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLE
envVars.description: Name of the environment variable holding the HMAC key material; exactly one of this or DATAPRISM_PRIVACY_HMAC_KEY_PROVIDER_REFERENCE is required, never both, and never a literal key value

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_PRIVACY_HMAC_KEY_PROVIDER_REFERENCE
envVars.description: Reference to an approved secret provider holding the HMAC key material; set this instead of DATAPRISM_PRIVACY_HMAC_KEY_ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLE, never both

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_AUDIT_SINK
envVars.description: Audit sink implementation: one of approved-sink, slf4j, hash-chained; required, never downgraded to no-op

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_AUDIT_WRITER_ID
envVars.description: Writer/instance identity recorded on every audit entry; required

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_AUDIT_FILE_PATH
envVars.description: Path to the durable, hash-chained audit log; required when DATAPRISM_AUDIT_SINK=hash-chained, refused as MISSING_AUDIT_FILE_PATH if absent for that sink, ignored otherwise

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_METRICS_SINK
envVars.description: Metrics sink binding, currently only micrometer; required in production, never the framework no-op

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_HAZELCAST_TOPOLOGY
envVars.description: Cluster read-budget topology: embedded (shared across members that have joined one cluster; set cluster name and join mode) or single-node (enforced per process); required, never defaulted

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_HAZELCAST_CLUSTERNAME
envVars.description: Hazelcast cluster name; required when DATAPRISM_HAZELCAST_TOPOLOGY=embedded, never dev, refused if set with single-node

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_HAZELCAST_JOIN_MODE
envVars.description: How cluster members find each other: tcp-ip, kubernetes or none; required when DATAPRISM_HAZELCAST_TOPOLOGY=embedded (none is an explicit single member bound to 127.0.0.1), refused if set with single-node

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_HAZELCAST_JOIN_MEMBERS
envVars.description: Comma-separated member addresses (host or host:port); required when DATAPRISM_HAZELCAST_JOIN_MODE=tcp-ip, otherwise unused

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_HAZELCAST_MEMBER_PORT
envVars.description: Hazelcast member port, default 5701, never auto-incremented; must differ from the server, management and operator ports. Member traffic is unencrypted, so keep it on a private network. Optional

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_OPERATOR_ENABLED
envVars.description: Enables the operator surface; optional, off by default

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_OPERATOR_PORT
envVars.description: Port of the operator listener; required when DATAPRISM_OPERATOR_ENABLED=true, must differ from the server, management (OPERATOR_PORT_SHARED otherwise) and member ports, and has no fixed default (publish it explicitly)

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_OPERATOR_REQUIREDAUDIENCE
envVars.description: JWT audience an operator token must carry; required when DATAPRISM_OPERATOR_ENABLED=true

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_OPERATOR_REQUIREDSCOPE
envVars.description: JWT scope an operator token must carry; required when DATAPRISM_OPERATOR_ENABLED=true

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_SOURCES_CUSTOMER_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Example only — declare DATAPRISM_SOURCES_<NAME>_BASE_URL (HTTPS) per configured source; at least one source, each with its own reviewed DataSourceAdapter bean, is required

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_SOURCES_CUSTOMER_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: Example only — declare DATAPRISM_SOURCES_<NAME>_TIMEOUT (positive duration) per configured source; required alongside its base URL

envVars.name: DB_DEFAULT_PROFILE

envVars.name: DB_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Connection timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 10000

envVars.name: DB_QUERY_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Server-side query timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 30000

envVars.name: DB_LOG
envVars.description: true logs every tool call, its statements and full output to stderr. Off by default

envVars.name: DB_LOG_FILE
envVars.description: Log every tool call to this file instead. Implies DB_LOG

envVars.name: DB_LOG_DIR
envVars.description: Save every tool call as its own JSON file in this folder, permanently. Implies logging

envVars.name: DB_LOG_FORMAT
envVars.description: pretty (default) or json, one object per line

envVars.name: DB_LOG_PORT
envVars.description: Serve a live log viewer in the browser on this port. Needs DB_LOG_DIR, DB_LOG or DB_LOG_FILE. No access control

envVars.name: DB_LOG_HISTORY
envVars.description: Entries the viewer keeps in memory when DB_LOG_DIR is not set. Defaults to 500

envVars.description: Required: the dense retrieval leg embeds the 438-record catalogue during startup warmup and the server refuses to start when the endpoint is unreachable. TEI embeddings endpoint: on the Docker host use http://host.docker.internal:8080 (add --add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway on Linux); on a shared Docker network use http://design-pattern-tei-embed:8080.

envVars.name: DESIGN_PATTERN_EMBEDDER_API_KEY
envVars.description: API key for the embedder. Keyless TEI accepts any non-empty value; use 'not-needed' there.

envVars.name: DESIGN_PATTERN_RERANKER_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Required: retrieval runs a mandatory TEI cross-encoder rerank whenever the fused pool has more than one candidate. On the Docker host use http://host.docker.internal:8080; on a shared Docker network use http://design-pattern-tei-rerank:8080.

envVars.name: S3_BUCKET

envVars.description: Set to exactly `true` to register delete_file. Off by default because deleting is not recoverable and an agent that misreads a sentence deletes the wrong thing silently.

envVars.name: FILELAYER_MCP_EXPOSE_AUDIT
envVars.description: Set to exactly `true` to register file_audit. Off by default because the trail is an organisation's whole history and a tool that returns it copies every file name, actor and denial into the model's context. Reading it is itself audited since 0.27.0, which was the previous reason; the default did not move.

envVars.name: FILELAYER_MCP_RETURN_BYTES
envVars.description: Set to exactly `true` to register read_file. Off by default because a document returned by a tool is a document copied into a model's context; file_info plus a share link is usually what was actually needed.

name: GitLab MCP Server
description: GitLab MCP server for projects, merge requests, issues, pipelines, wiki, releases, and more.

envVars.name: GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN
envVars.description: GitLab personal access token for local stdio use. A non-empty value overrides GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN_FILE. One of this token, GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN_FILE, GITLAB_JOB_TOKEN, GITLAB_AUTH_COOKIE_PATH, or GITLAB_USE_OAUTH=true must be set. Create a token with the GitLab scopes the tools need, such as api or read_api.

envVars.name: GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN_FILE
envVars.description: Path to a file that contains the personal access token. Read once at startup and trimmed. Ignored when GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN or --token is non-empty. A missing, unreadable, or empty file stops startup. Does not replace job token, OAuth, cookie, or remote authorization.

envVars.name: GITLAB_JOB_TOKEN
envVars.description: Optional GitLab CI job token to use instead of a personal access token when running inside GitLab CI.

envVars.name: GITLAB_AUTH_COOKIE_PATH
envVars.description: Optional path to a GitLab authentication cookie file for cookie-based authentication.

envVars.name: GITLAB_USE_OAUTH
envVars.description: Set to true to start with GitLab OAuth instead of a personal access token, job token, or cookie file.

envVars.name: GITLAB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
envVars.description: GitLab OAuth application ID. When GITLAB_USE_OAUTH=true, set this or GITLAB_OAUTH_TOKEN_SCRIPT.

envVars.name: GITLAB_OAUTH_TOKEN_SCRIPT
envVars.description: Command that prints an OAuth access token. When GITLAB_USE_OAUTH=true, set this or GITLAB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.

envVars.name: GITLAB_API_URL
envVars.description: GitLab API base URL. Use https://gitlab.com/api/v4 for GitLab.com or your self-managed GitLab API URL.

envVars.name: GITLAB_ALLOWED_PROJECT_IDS
envVars.description: Optional comma-separated list of GitLab project IDs that this server is allowed to access.

envVars.name: GITLAB_PERMISSION_MODE
envVars.description: Tool exposure. Allowed values are readonly, modify, and full. Unset uses full. readonly keeps read-only tools. modify blocks delete and teardown tools.

envVars.name: GITLAB_TOOLSETS
envVars.description: Optional comma-separated list of toolsets to enable, such as projects, issues, merge_requests, pipelines, releases, users, groups, wiki, or search.

envVars.name: GITLAB_TOOLS
envVars.description: Optional comma-separated list of individual tool names to add on top of enabled toolsets.

envVars.name: GITLAB_DENIED_TOOLS_REGEX
envVars.description: Optional regular expression used to hide matching tools from the server.

envVars.name: GITLAB_TOOL_POLICY_APPROVE
envVars.description: Optional comma-separated list of tool names that require explicit approval before execution.

envVars.name: GITLAB_TOOL_POLICY_HIDDEN
envVars.description: Optional comma-separated list of tool names to hide from tools/list.

envVars.name: NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED
envVars.description: Set to 0 only when you intentionally need to connect to a GitLab instance with invalid or self-signed TLS certificates.

envVars.name: GITLAB_CA_CERT_PATH
envVars.description: Optional path to a custom CA certificate file for self-managed GitLab instances.

envVars.name: GITLAB_MASKING_ENABLED
envVars.description: Set to true to mask text tool results and returned errors using built-in or configured rules.

envVars.name: GITLAB_MASKING_CONFIG
envVars.description: Optional path to a response-masking JSON configuration file.

envVars.name: GITLAB_MASKING_POLICY_FILE
envVars.description: Optional protected server-owned JSON file containing managed masking policies.

envVars.name: GITLAB_MASKING_WORKSPACE_DIR
envVars.description: Directory used to resolve response-masking configuration paths.

envVars.description: Folder of the Godot project (the one containing project.godot). Defaults to the folder the client starts the server in, so set it whenever that is not your project (e.g. in desktop apps).

envVars.description: Full path of the Godot 4.x executable (GODOT_BIN is accepted too). If unset, the server looks for godot, godot4 or Godot_v4* on PATH. On Windows use the main Godot exe, not the _console.exe launcher.

envVars.name: GODOT_MCP_MODE
envVars.description: How tools are exposed: 'full' lists every enabled operation as its own tool (best for clients with tool search); 'compact' lists only core tools plus router tools that reach the rest.

envVars.name: GODOT_MCP_TOOLSETS
envVars.description: Comma-separated tool groups to enable, or 'all' (default). Groups: core, files, scene, node, script, run, editor, signal, resource, visual, anim, world, audio, project, import, export, code, docs, game, debug, test. 'core' is always on.

envVars.name: GODOT_MCP_READ_ONLY
envVars.description: Set to true to hide every tool that changes something (inspection only).

envVars.name: GODOT_MCP_ALLOW_EVAL
envVars.description: Set to true to let godot_game_eval run GDScript inside the running game. Off by default: evaluated code can do anything the game can (files, OS calls).

envVars.name: GODOT_MCP_CONFIRM
envVars.description: 'elicit' asks the user (through the client's elicitation dialog, when supported) before irreversible operations; 'never' skips asking, for unattended runs where nobody can answer.

envVars.name: GODOT_MCP_LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Verbosity of the server's stderr log (use 'debug' when filing a bug report).

envVars.name: GODOT_MCP_HEADLESS_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Advanced: timeout for one headless Godot invocation, in milliseconds.

envVars.name: GODOT_MCP_BRIDGE_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Advanced: timeout for one request to the live editor bridge, in milliseconds.

envVars.name: GODOT_MCP_LSP_PORT
envVars.description: Advanced: port of the Godot editor's GDScript language server on 127.0.0.1. Defaults to the port the editor plugin reports, else 6005.

envVars.name: GODOT_MCP_LSP_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Advanced: timeout for one GDScript language server request, in milliseconds.

envVars.name: GODOT_MCP_LSP_IDLE_MS
envVars.description: Advanced: stop the private headless language server after this many milliseconds without code tool calls.

envVars.name: GODOT_MCP_CACHE_DIR
envVars.description: Advanced: folder for the server's cache (the Godot class docs index). Defaults to the per-user cache folder of the OS.

description: Computer use for Hyprland: semantic desktop state over IPC, plus vision and native input

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_SCREENSHOT_MODE
envVars.description: How captures are returned: 'file' writes to XDG_RUNTIME_DIR and returns the path, 'image' returns the image inline. Use 'image' for clients that render MCP images but cannot read files, such as Claude Desktop.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_READONLY
envVars.description: Set to 1 to expose only the observation tools (desktop, screenshot, zoom, ui, marks, binds, wait_for). The agent can see and narrate but cannot click, type, or launch.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_CONFINE
envVars.description: Restrict input to a scope of windows and refuse everything outside it: 'launched' (only windows hypruse opened this session), 'class:firefox,kitty', or 'workspace:3,special:notes'. Unset means no confinement.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_AUTH_GUARD
envVars.description: Refuse to click or type into system authentication dialogs (polkit, keyring prompts). On by default; 'strict' also refuses password fields in ordinary windows; 0 disables it.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_STRICT
envVars.description: Set to 1 to refuse to act when the cursor or focused window moved since hypruse's last action, so the agent must re-read the desktop before retrying.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_MARK
envVars.description: Set to 1 to make the agent's presence legible: tag every window it opens 'hypruse-owned' and flash an on-screen notice when it opens a window or captures the screen.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_CLIPBOARD
envVars.description: Set to 1 to register the opt-in clipboard tool (never in read-only mode). Off by default because clipboards hold passwords.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_JOURNAL
envVars.description: Record every tool call, refusals included, as one NDJSON line: 1 writes to XDG_STATE_HOME/hypruse/journal.ndjson, or give a path. Read it back with 'hypruse journal'. Off by default.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_JOURNAL_MAX_BYTES
envVars.description: Rotate the journal once it reaches this size, keeping one previous generation alongside it. Set 0 to never rotate.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_JOURNAL_TEXT
envVars.description: Set to 1 to record typed and copied text in the journal verbatim instead of as a length plus digest. Off by default because keystrokes are passwords; needed only to replay typing.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_DRYRUN
envVars.description: Set to 1 for a rehearsal: every acting tool validates its arguments and runs every trust guard, then reports what it would have done and delivers no input.

envVars.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_KV_STORE_URL

envVars.description: Comma-separated explicit tool names this instance exposes; every other tool is hidden from listings and cannot be invoked. Names matching no registered tool are inert. Mutually exclusive with `tools_deny`. Takes effect through `apply_tool_visibility`.

envVars.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_TOOLS_DENY
envVars.description: Comma-separated explicit tool names hidden from this instance (absent from listings, cannot be invoked). Names matching no registered tool are inert. Mutually exclusive with `tools_allow`. Takes effect through `apply_tool_visibility`.

envVars.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_SERVER_NAME
envVars.description: Rename this server instance; defaults to the project name.

envVars.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_INSTRUCTIONS
envVars.description: Replaces the default MCP instructions text sent to clients.

envVars.name: FASTMCP_LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Log level for FastMCP internals and app loggers (DEBUG / INFO / WARNING / ERROR / CRITICAL). The -v CLI flag overrides to DEBUG.

envVars.name: FASTMCP_ENABLE_RICH_LOGGING
envVars.description: Set false for plain or structured JSON log output.

envVars.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_A1111_HOST
envVars.description: Deprecated alias for IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_SD_WEBUI_HOST; logs a warning when used.

envVars.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_A1111_MODEL
envVars.description: Deprecated alias for IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_SD_WEBUI_MODEL; logs a warning when used.

envVars.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_READ_ONLY
envVars.description: When true, write-tagged tools (image generation, transforms, uploads) are hidden from clients. Set false to enable them.

envVars.description: Directory where generated images are saved. Created automatically on first use.

envVars.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_OPENAI_API_KEY
envVars.description: OpenAI API key. Enables the OpenAI provider (gpt-image-2, gpt-image-1.5, dall-e-3) when set.

envVars.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_DEFAULT_PROVIDER

envVars.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_TRANSFORM_CACHE_SIZE

envVars.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_PAID_PROVIDERS
envVars.description: Comma-separated provider names that cost money; generate_image asks for confirmation (client elicitation) before using them. An empty value falls back to this default; to disable confirmation, set a value that names no provider (such as none).

envVars.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_STYLES_DIR

envVars.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_ALLOW_LOCAL_FILE_INPUT

envVars.description: Maximum accepted input image size in bytes.

envVars.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_FETCH_TIMEOUT_S
envVars.description: HTTP timeout in seconds when fetching remote image URLs (fetch_image and URL inputs).

envVars.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_TRANSFER_TTL_DEFAULT_S
envVars.description: Link lifetime in seconds when the caller requests no explicit TTL.

envVars.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_TRANSFER_TTL_MAX_S

name: io.form/formio-mcp
description: Create and manage Form.io forms, resources, actions, roles, and projects from your AI agent.

envVars.name: FORMIO_PROJECT_URL
envVars.description: Optional, and the WEAKEST of the three project sources: a committed formio.json found by walking up from the working directory wins, then the per-directory mapping project_set writes, then this. It pins nothing — project_set can redirect a directory whose environment names a different project. Useful for a launch with nowhere to record a project, such as CI or a container (e.g. https://examples.form.io on the hosted cloud; self-hosted it is either https://your-project.your-domain.com or https://your-host/project-name, depending on how that deployment routes projects). Leave it unset and the agent asks for a project and records it per directory.

envVars.name: FORMIO_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Optional, and usually unnecessary: the base URL is DERIVED from the project URL — https://api.form.io for a project on a form.io host, the parent path for a project addressed as a sub-directory — and is asked for only when it cannot be derived, which is a path-less project URL on a customer domain. There is no default. Like FORMIO_PROJECT_URL it is the weakest source, behind a committed formio.json and the per-directory mapping.

envVars.name: FORMIO_API_KEY
envVars.description: Form.io project API key. Optional — applied only to the project FORMIO_PROJECT_URL names, so set FORMIO_PROJECT_URL beside it; any other project, and every project when it is omitted, uses the browser-based portal login flow to obtain a JWT.

envVars.name: FORMIO_LOGIN_FORM
envVars.description: URL of a custom login form used by the browser-based portal login flow. Defaults to the deployment's portal login form.

envVars.name: FORMIO_AUTH_HOST
envVars.description: Address the browser-login page binds to. Optional; defaults to 127.0.0.1. Set it to 0.0.0.0, together with FORMIO_AUTH_PORT, when the server runs in a container or on a remote machine and the login page must be reachable through a published port. 0.0.0.0 exposes the page on every interface for the duration of a login.

envVars.name: FORMIO_AUTH_PORT
envVars.description: Fixed port for the browser-login page, so a container can publish it (e.g. 43117). Optional; a positive integer, and by default the page takes an ephemeral port.

envVars.name: FORMIO_AUTH_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: Seconds to wait for a browser login before the call fails with an error naming the remedies. Optional; a positive integer no larger than 2147483, and any other value is ignored. Defaults to 900.

envVars.name: FORMIO_FORCE_BROWSER
envVars.description: Set to 1 to attempt the browser login even where the server detects it cannot present one (CI, a container, a remote shell with no display). Use it when the login page is reachable from a browser elsewhere.

envVars.name: FORMIO_REQUEST_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: Seconds a Form.io request may go unanswered before the call fails with a network error naming the URL. Optional; a positive integer no larger than 2147483, and any other value is ignored. Defaults to 60. project_import and project_export wait 300 seconds, or this value when it is longer.

envVars.name: FORMIO_INSECURE_TLS
envVars.description: Set to 1 to skip TLS certificate verification only for requests to the configured deployment (the hosts of the resolved project URL and base URL); every other host is verified as usual. For local development against self-signed certificates only — never enable in production.

envVars.name: ONELY_WALLET_PROVIDER
envVars.description: Wallet provider to use. 'raw' (default) uses local key files via ONELY_WALLET_SOLANA_KEY or ONELY_WALLET_EVM_KEY. 'coinbase' uses Coinbase Agentic Wallet (Base network only, requires the wallet app running locally).

envVars.name: ONELY_NETWORK
envVars.description: Preferred blockchain network for payments. 'solana' (default) or 'base'. Determines which wallet is used when an API supports both networks.

envVars.name: ONELY_SOLANA_RPC_URL
envVars.description: Solana RPC endpoint URL. Defaults to https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com. Use a private RPC (e.g. Helius, Quicknode) for better reliability and rate limits.

envVars.name: ONELY_BUDGET_PER_CALL
envVars.description: Maximum USD amount allowed per single paid API call. Defaults to 1.00. The server will refuse any call priced above this limit.

envVars.name: ONELY_BUDGET_DAILY
envVars.description: Maximum total USD spending per calendar day (UTC). Defaults to 50.00. Resets at UTC midnight. The server will refuse calls that would exceed this limit.

envVars.name: ONELY_BUDGET_STATE_FILE
envVars.description: Path to the local JSON file used to track daily spending. Defaults to ~/.1ly-mcp-budget.json. Created automatically with owner-only permissions (0600).

envVars.name: ONELY_SOLANA_DRY_RUN
envVars.description: Set to '1' to simulate Solana transactions without broadcasting to the blockchain. Returns a fake signature. Use for testing only — no real payments will be made.

envVars.name: ONELY_API_BASE
envVars.description: Override the 1ly.store API base URL. Defaults to https://1ly.store. Only http://localhost:PORT is accepted as an alternative (for local development). Do not change in production.

envVars.name: AGA_GATEWAY_KEY
envVars.description: Ed25519 seed, 64 hex characters, that signs this server's evidence-bundle receipts and checkpoint, so gateway_public_key (get_server_info) is the same after a restart and can be pinned. Set in your MCP client's configuration, the seed sits inside the governed client's trust domain. Receipts are kept in memory only; save a generate_evidence_bundle result before the server stops. Unset or invalid: a new key each start, warned on stderr. When set, even to an invalid value, AGA_GATEWAY_KEY_FILE is not read.

envVars.name: AGA_GATEWAY_KEY_FILE
envVars.description: Path to a file holding the 64-hex Ed25519 seed; read only when AGA_GATEWAY_KEY is unset or empty, with the same effect. A stdio server started by your MCP client runs as the client's OS user, so the file sits inside the governed client's trust domain. Missing, unreadable or invalid: a new key each start, warned on stderr.

envVars.description: Your Apple ID email, for iCloud Calendar, Contacts and Mail.

envVars.name: ICLOUD_APP_PASSWORD
envVars.description: An app-specific password from appleid.apple.com → Sign-In and Security → App-Specific Passwords (NOT your Apple ID password).

envVars.name: ICLOUD_MAIL_ADDRESS
envVars.description: Your @icloud.com address, only if your Apple ID email is not an iCloud address (needed for Mail).

envVars.name: ICLOUD_DEFAULT_CALENDAR
envVars.description: Calendar new events go to when none is named (default: the first writable event calendar).

envVars.name: APPLE_WRITE_MODE
envVars.description: "none" = read-only tools; "additive" = also create/append, never modify, delete or send; "all" = everything (default). Unrecognized values fail closed to "none".

envVars.description: Comma-separated services to enable (music, calendar, contacts, mail, maps, weather, itunes). Default: all.

envVars.description: IANA time zone (e.g. America/New_York) for displayed times and for dates you give without an offset. Set this on a hosted server, which runs in UTC.

envVars.description: "metric" (default) or "imperial" units for weather (Maps distances always show both).

envVars.name: APPLE_STATE_CACHE
envVars.description: Set to false to write nothing under $MCP_DATA_DIR/.apple-icloud-mcp: no web-player token or iCloud discovery cache, and the rejected-password latch and spent confirmation tokens then last only as long as the process.

envVars.name: APPLE_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds (default 30000).

envVars.name: APPLE_DEBUG_LOG
envVars.description: Set to 1 to log every upstream request line to stderr (credentials redacted).

envVars.name: MCP_CONFIRM_MODE
envVars.description: How confirm-gated writes (send mail, deletes, removing tracks, invitations) behave on a client with no prompt, like claude.ai: "ask-user" (default: preview + confirmToken, the model must get your OK), "auto", or "refuse". Unknown values mean refuse.

envVars.name: MCP_CONFIRM_ELICITATION
envVars.description: "off" never shows a confirmation prompt, so every client gets the MCP_CONFIRM_MODE flow. Set it for a client that says it can prompt but never does (the gated call hangs, e.g. opencode 2.0.x). Any other value stays "on" (with a stderr warning).

envVars.name: MCP_CONFIRM_TTL_SECONDS
envVars.description: Lifetime of a confirmToken in seconds (default 600).

envVars.name: MCP_CONFIRM_SECRET
envVars.description: Signing key for confirmTokens. Random per process by default; set it so a token issued just before a restart or redeploy still works (spent tokens are recorded on disk, so none can be replayed).

envVars.description: Set to false to keep the captured token in memory only. Defaults to on: it is cached so a restart within its ~23h lifetime needs no browser.

envVars.description: What the writes (teams_send_message, teams_react, teams_mark_read and the read tools' mark_read) do on a client that cannot show a confirmation prompt (claude.ai, Claude Desktop): "ask-user" (default: the first call returns a preview and a confirmToken, and the model must get your approval in chat before using it), "auto" (the model may use the token after reviewing the preview itself) or "refuse". name: io.github.chrischall/ofw-mcp
description: OurFamilyWizard co-parenting for Claude — messages, calendar, expenses, and journal

envVars.name: OFW_USERNAME
envVars.description: Your OurFamilyWizard login email address. Optional — if omitted, the server falls back to the fetchproxy browser extension (requires being signed in to ourfamilywizard.com).

envVars.name: OFW_PASSWORD
envVars.description: Your OurFamilyWizard password. Optional — see OFW_USERNAME.

envVars.name: OFW_WRITE_MODE
envVars.description: Write-tool gate: "none" registers no write tools; "drafts" registers draft-level writes only (save/delete drafts, upload attachments); "all" registers everything (default). Unrecognized values fail closed to "none".

envVars.name: OFW_CALENDAR_WRITES
envVars.description: Set to "true" to register calendar write tools (create/update/delete event) in "drafts" write mode. Events have no draft stage but are reversible. Never overrides "none".

envVars.name: OFW_ALLOW_MARK_READ
envVars.description: Default "true". Set "false" to forbid any tool from marking a message read on OurFamilyWizard - reading a body for the first time stamps a co-parent-visible "First Viewed" time that cannot be undone. A ceiling: no per-call argument can raise it.

envVars.name: OFW_FETCH_UNREAD_BODIES
envVars.description: Default "false". Whether ofw_sync_messages fetches unread inbox bodies by default (each fetch stamps a First Viewed time). Capped by OFW_ALLOW_MARK_READ.

envVars.name: OFW_READ_DAYS
envVars.description: Allow list of days message content may be read, e.g. "mon,thu" (weekdays, YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD, in DISPLAY_TZ). Other days: subjects only, nothing marked read. Unset = every day.

envVars.name: OFW_NO_READ_DAYS
envVars.description: Deny list of days message content may NOT be read (same format as OFW_READ_DAYS; wins over it). Unset = none.

envVars.name: OFW_SESSION_CACHE
envVars.description: Set to false to disable the on-disk session cache and re-authenticate on every process start. Defaults to enabled.

envVars.name: OFW_SESSION_FILE
envVars.description: Absolute path for the session cache file. Defaults to $MCP_DATA_DIR/.ofw-mcp/session.json.

envVars.name: OFW_EXPENSE_ONLY
envVars.description: Set true to register only healthcheck plus expense tools. All profile/dashboard, message, calendar, and journal tools are structurally absent.

envVars.name: OFW_EXPENSE_UPLOAD_ONLY
envVars.description: Set true for strict reimbursement upload mode: only healthcheck, ofw_upload_expense_pdf, ofw_create_expense, and ofw_update_expense register. Implies OFW_EXPENSE_ONLY.

envVars.name: OFW_INLINE_ATTACHMENTS
envVars.description: Set "true" to return attachments as MCP content blocks by default (images render directly; other files come back as embedded resources) instead of writing to disk. Callers can still override per call via the tool's `inline` argument.

envVars.name: OFW_ATTACHMENTS_DIR
envVars.description: Where ofw_download_attachment writes (default ~/Downloads/ofw-mcp). Every disk write is confined to it: a saveTo outside it (after resolving symlinks) is refused, and an existing file is replaced only with force:true.

envVars.name: OFW_UPLOAD_DIR
envVars.description: The only directory ofw_upload_attachment may read from (default: OFW_ATTACHMENTS_DIR). Paths outside it after resolving symlinks, hidden files/dirs, and files over 25 MiB are refused.

envVars.name: OFW_CACHE_IDENTITY
envVars.description: Explicit cache-key label; overrides OFW_USERNAME for fetchproxy-only multi-account setups. If you have multiple OFW accounts and want them to use separate caches, set it to a label per profile.

envVars.name: OFW_CACHE_DIR
envVars.description: Overrides the message cache directory (default ~/.cache/ofw-mcp).

envVars.name: OFW_DISABLE_FETCHPROXY
envVars.description: Skip the fetchproxy fallback, so missing credentials become a hard error (useful in headless CI).

envVars.name: OFW_AUTO_REFRESH
envVars.description: When a cached read comes back EMPTY from a non-fresh cache, the read tools sync the backing folders and answer from the refreshed cache instead of refusing with UNVERIFIED_EMPTY (default off, i.e. refuse). Per-call autoRefresh overrides it. A refresh that does not make the read verifiable still refuses.

envVars.name: OFW_FRESHNESS_TTL_SECONDS
envVars.description: How long a verified-against-OFW folder stays labelled `fresh` in read tools' `freshness` block (default 300). Unusable values fall back to the default — a typo must never widen the window in which stale data reads as current.

envVars.name: OFW_SYNC_MAX_REQUESTS
envVars.description: Per-call OFW-request budget for ofw_sync_messages: a positive integer caps how many OFW requests one sync call may make before pausing; the next call resumes where it left off. Unset means unbounded (local installs walk fully in one call).

envVars.name: OFW_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Per-request timeout for OFW API calls, in milliseconds (default 30000). Each retry gets its own fresh window.

envVars.name: OFW_DEBUG_LOG
envVars.description: Log every OFW request/response to stderr (Authorization redacted). Diagnostic only.

envVars.name: DISPLAY_TZ
envVars.description: IANA zone (e.g. America/New_York, the default) for every `<field>Display` value, and the zone a NAIVE source timestamp is assumed to be wall-clock in. OFW's API reports naive local times in the account's own zone, so this must match it. Unrecognized values fall back to the default.

envVars.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_PORT
envVars.description: Localhost port of the fetchproxy concentrator the ContextMint Bridge extension connects to (default 37149). Every MCP on one machine shares it, so move it for all of them or not at all.

envVars.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_HOST

name: io.github.claymore666/ccu-mcp
description: MCP server for controlling HomeMatic smart home devices via the CCU JSON-RPC API

envVars.name: CCU_HOST
envVars.description: Hostname or IP of your HomeMatic CCU (debmatic, CCU3, or OpenCCU/RaspberryMatic)

envVars.name: CCU_PASSWORD
envVars.description: CCU admin password (same as the WebUI login). Must be set; the value may be empty for a CCU with no password

envVars.name: CCU_USER
envVars.description: CCU username

envVars.name: CCU_HTTPS
envVars.description: Connect to the CCU via HTTPS (self-signed certificates supported)

envVars.name: CCU_PORT
envVars.description: CCU API port (80 for HTTP, 443 for HTTPS)

envVars.name: CACHE_DIR
envVars.description: Directory for the device type cache and session persistence

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
envVars.description: Comma-separated allowlist of browser origins. Unset = no cross-origin browser access (default-deny). An allowlisted origin is reflected exactly in Access-Control-Allow-Origin (never '*'); the list also drives DNS-rebinding origin checks

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
envVars.description: Extra Host header values accepted by DNS-rebinding protection (comma-separated host:port); add your hostname when behind a proxy or container DNS name

envVars.name: CCU_PROFILES
envVars.description: Comma-separated names of multiple CCU targets (e.g. 'prod,dev'). Each profile takes the flat CCU_* settings prefixed CCU_<NAME>_ (CCU_PROD_HOST, ...), plus policy flags CCU_<NAME>_PROTECTED (writes need confirm:true) and CCU_<NAME>_READONLY. Unset = single default profile from the flat CCU_* vars

envVars.name: CCU_DEFAULT_PROFILE
envVars.description: Which profile from CCU_PROFILES is active at startup (default: the first listed)

envVars.name: CCU_TLS_VERIFY
envVars.description: Verify the CCU's TLS certificate against the system trust store. Only meaningful with CCU_HTTPS=true. Default false, because a CCU ships a self-signed certificate — prefer CCU_TLS_FINGERPRINT or CCU_CA_CERT to verify one of those

envVars.name: CCU_TLS_FINGERPRINT
envVars.description: Pin the CCU's self-signed leaf certificate by its SHA-256 fingerprint (hex, colons optional). The strongest option for an appliance: the connection is rejected unless the presented certificate matches. Takes precedence over CCU_CA_CERT

envVars.name: CCU_CA_CERT
envVars.description: Path to a PEM file holding the CCU's CA or self-signed certificate. The connection is then validated against it with standard chain verification

envVars.name: CCU_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: Timeout for a CCU JSON-RPC call, in MILLISECONDS

envVars.name: CCU_SCRIPT_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: Timeout for HomeMatic Script execution (ReGa), in MILLISECONDS — scripts are slower than plain API calls

envVars.name: CACHE_TTL
envVars.description: Lifetime of the on-disk device-type schema cache, in SECONDS

envVars.name: CCU_RATE_LIMIT_BURST
envVars.description: Token-bucket burst size for CCU requests — how many may be issued back to back

envVars.name: CCU_RATE_LIMIT_RATE
envVars.description: Sustained CCU request rate, in requests per second

envVars.name: RESOURCE_POLL_INTERVAL
envVars.description: How often MCP resources are polled for change notifications, in SECONDS

envVars.name: LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: error | warn | info | debug. Logs are structured JSON on stderr

description: MCP server for managing Coalesce Transform workspaces, nodes, pipelines, and runs.

envVars.name: COALESCE_ACCESS_TOKEN
envVars.description: Bearer token from the Coalesce Deploy tab. Optional when `~/.coa/config` provides a `token`.

envVars.name: COALESCE_PROFILE
envVars.description: Selects which `~/.coa/config` profile to load. Defaults to default.

envVars.name: COALESCE_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Region-specific base URL. Defaults to https://app.coalescesoftware.io (US).

envVars.name: COALESCE_ORG_ID
envVars.description: Fallback org ID for cancel-run. Also readable from `orgID` in the active ~/.coa/config profile.

envVars.name: COALESCE_REPO_PATH
envVars.description: Local repo root for repo-backed tools and pipeline planning. Also readable from `repoPath` in the active ~/.coa/config profile.

envVars.name: COALESCE_CACHE_DIR
envVars.description: Base directory for the local data cache. When set, cache files are written here instead of the working directory. Also readable from `cacheDir` in the active ~/.coa/config profile.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_AUTO_CACHE_MAX_BYTES
envVars.description: JSON size threshold before auto-caching to disk. Defaults to 32768.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_INLINE_RESPONSES
envVars.description: Forces large responses inline as text instead of auto-caching them to disk and returning a `resource_link` (and suppresses per-field cache resource links). The server already auto-enables this for clients known not to support MCP resources (e.g. Snowflake Cortex), which otherwise render the link as unreadable "binary data" and retry in a loop. Set `true` to force it on for an unrecognised client, or `false` to disable auto-detection. Leave unset for Claude/Cursor to keep large payloads out of context. Defaults to false (auto-enabled for resource-less clients).

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_LINEAGE_TTL_MS
envVars.description: In-memory lineage cache TTL in milliseconds. Defaults to 1800000.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_MAX_REQUEST_BODY_BYTES
envVars.description: Max outbound API request body size. Defaults to 524288.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Default per-request timeout for Coalesce API calls. Raise on large workspaces where paginated reads exceed the default. Defaults to 60000.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_DETAIL_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Per-page timeout for detail=true paginated fetches of large node lists. Defaults to 180000.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_NODE_TYPE_RANKING_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Deadline for the best-effort workspace-adoption node-type ranking lookup inside node creation. Advisory only — creation proceeds without a ranking suggestion if this trips. Defaults to 15000.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_INVENTORY_CACHE_TTL_MS
envVars.description: In-memory TTL for the workspace node-type inventory. Set to `0` to disable. Defaults to 300000.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_NODE_INDEX_CACHE_TTL_MS
envVars.description: In-memory TTL for the workspace node-index (id/name/type/location) cache used by SQL- and intent-ref resolution. Set to `0` to disable. Defaults to 300000.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_NODE_DETAIL_CACHE_TTL_MS
envVars.description: In-memory TTL for the workspace node-detail (full body) cache used by review and predecessor lookups. Set to `0` to disable. Defaults to 300000.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_READ_ONLY
envVars.description: When `true`, hides all write/mutation tools during registration. Only read, list, search, cache, analyze, review, diagnose, and plan tools are exposed. Defaults to false.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_SKILLS_DIR
envVars.description: Directory for customizable AI skill resources. When set, reads context resources from this directory and seeds defaults on first run. Users can augment or override any skill.

envVars.name: SNOWFLAKE_ACCOUNT
envVars.description: Snowflake account identifier (e.g., `abc12345.us-east-1`). Required by the local `coa` CLI and `coa doctor`; not used by the MCP's REST run path. (required for run tools)

envVars.name: SNOWFLAKE_USERNAME
envVars.description: Snowflake account username (required for run tools)

envVars.name: SNOWFLAKE_KEY_PAIR_KEY
envVars.description: Path to PEM-encoded private key (required if SNOWFLAKE_PAT not set)

envVars.name: SNOWFLAKE_PAT
envVars.description: Snowflake Programmatic Access Token (alternative to key pair)

envVars.name: SNOWFLAKE_KEY_PAIR_PASS
envVars.description: Passphrase for encrypted keys

envVars.name: SNOWFLAKE_WAREHOUSE
envVars.description: Snowflake compute warehouse (required for run tools)

envVars.name: SNOWFLAKE_ROLE
envVars.description: Snowflake user role (required for run tools)

envVars.description: Couchbase client certificate path. Required for mTLS authentication.
